title: Insecure Direct Object Reference (IDOR) in Document Service
description: Document fetch endpoint returns documents by identifier without checking owner permissions.
security_invariant: Callers may only access documents they own or have been explicitly granted permission to view.
expected_vulnerable_behavior: Caller 'bob' fetches 'doc-101' owned by 'alice' and receives full document payload.
required_secure_behavior: Caller 'bob' attempting to fetch 'doc-101' owned by 'alice' raises PermissionError.
